title: Here’s what data Comcast says its motion-detecting routers collect
summary: Sloan said “WiFi Motion is opt in only by a customer,” and that “No, Comcast does not monitor customers’ motion activity or notifications in real time,” but did not say whether Comcast has the technical ability to do either.
